linked_form.no_template: Linked-form action is missing the target template setting (template_id)
linked_form.no_query: Linked-form open mode is missing the query setting
linked_form.no_host: Linked-form action cannot continue because HostServices is unavailable
linked_form.fill_bad_ref: Fill expressions may only reference current-form fields/system variables/constants (referenced target template table {alias}, whose record does not exist yet when creating)
linked_form.v1_unsupported_open: Linked-form "open" received no query result (node {node_id}, target template {template_id}). Common cause: the open condition references a detail-table field of the current form other than the table holding the triggering row. Adjust the open condition and retry; if the condition is correct, ask an administrator to check the system log
linked_form.v1_unsupported_create: Linked-form "create/fill" received no prefill result (node {node_id}, target template {template_id}). Common cause: a fill expression references a detail-table field of the current form other than the table holding the triggering row. Adjust the fill mapping and retry; if the mapping is correct, ask an administrator to check the system log
